name: HRC_LOADER_BATCH_HEADER
description: The header table is the top level table for a batch data load.

columns.name: LOADER_BATCH_ID
columns.description: LOADER_BATCH_ID

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: LOADER_AM_NAME
columns.description: LOADER_AM_NAME

columns.name: LOADER_AM_CONFIG_NAME
columns.description: LOADER_AM_CONFIG_NAME

columns.name: BATCH_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the batch load job.

columns.name: BATCH_STATUS_TEXT
columns.description: Status description for the batch load job.

columns.name: VALIDATE_ONLY
columns.description: If true, then only validate data and no data base commit.

columns.name: NUM_THREADS
columns.description: Number of threads to process job.

columns.name: CURRENT_CHUNK_NUM
columns.description: Current chunk being processed if running in parallel.

columns.name: TOTAL_NUM_CHUNKS
columns.description: Total number of discrete chunks of data in the batch lines table.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: User id of the user to start the batch load job.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: NOTIFICATION_CLASS
columns.description: Full path name for the class used to notify pre and post processing for this batch.

columns.name: UPDATE_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: When defining the column, the DB column comments should be "Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that last updated the row."

columns.name: XFER_JOB_ID
columns.description: Holds the file transfer identifier if the header was created from due to file processing.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Batch Name

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
